title: Coherent squares in the functor category from a free enriched edge
statement:
Use the universes and coherent enriched algebroids of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], the free algebroid of [lem-coef-algebroid-presentability], its completion of [lem-coef-algebroid-completion], and the enriched internal Hom and underlying infinity category of [lem-coef-enriched-category-tensor-calculus]. Let $\mathcal V$ be a presentably symmetric monoidal infinity category, let $\mathcal E$ be a small complete $\mathcal V$-category, and let $v\in\mathcal V$. Let $F_v$ be the free algebroid on objects $0,1$ and one generating edge $v$ from $0$ to $1$, with no other generating edges, and put $T_v=LF_v$. Set $B_v=U\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathcal V}(T_v,\mathcal E)$, with endpoint evaluation $e:B_v\to U\mathcal E\times U\mathcal E$.

There is a coherent square presentation of $B_v$ over its endpoint category. Its objects are triples $(x,y,a)$ with $a:v\to\mathcal E(x,y)$. For two such triples $a=(x,y,a)$ and $b=(x',y',b)$, put
$$M=\operatorname{Map}_{U\mathcal E}(x,x')\times\operatorname{Map}_{U\mathcal E}(y,y'),\qquad Z=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal V}(v,\mathcal E(x,y')).$$
Using enriched composition and the identification $\operatorname{Map}_{U\mathcal E}(z,w)=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal V}(\mathbf1,\mathcal E(z,w))$, define $d_0,d_1:M\to Z$ by $d_0(f,g)=b\circ f$ and $d_1(f,g)=g\circ a$. There is an equivalence over $M$
$$\operatorname{Map}_{B_v}(a,b)\simeq M\mathbin{\times}^{h}_{(d_0,d_1),\,Z\times Z,\,(\operatorname{ev}_0,\operatorname{ev}_1)}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,Z).$$
Thus a morphism is a pair of endpoint arrows and a path $b\circ f\simeq g\circ a$, retaining the entire path space, not just existence of a homotopy. These formulas extend to a presentation of the whole complete Segal nerve $R(B_v)_n=\operatorname{Fun}([n],B_v)^\simeq$: its coherent strings are strings of these squares, with all their higher compatibility data. Inner faces compose the endpoint arrows and paste the paths using enriched composition, outer faces restrict strings, and degeneracies insert identities and constant paths. The comparison to $B_v$ commutes coherently with these operations, endpoint evaluations, enriched functors of complete targets, maps of the coefficient object $v$ (by restriction), and additional small space-valued parameters. Spaces, paths, functor simplicial sets and cores have the meanings of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]; the complete Segal nerve convention is [lem-coef-complete-segal-quasicategory-comparison].

source.place: Remark 9.5 (internal Hom), with Gepner–Haugseng §4.3 Remark 4.3.4 (free graph). The free-edge square presentation is an agent-formulated refinement, not a quoted theorem; archival copies WANTED.
